sun-1-theirs: Their Sun in your 1st house: they see who you are from the very first moment. Being yourself around them can come more easily.
sun-1-yours: Your Sun in their 1st house: you seem familiar to them at first glance. Going unnoticed is hardly an option.
sun-5-theirs: Their Sun in your 5th house: playing and flirting with you comes naturally to them. The fun side of what's between you shows up early.
sun-5-yours: Your Sun in their 5th house: they see you as the person who lifts their mood. Their interest often shows up in a playful tone.
sun-7-theirs: Their Sun in your 7th house: they resemble what comes to mind when you picture a partner. One of the classic partnership placements.
sun-7-yours: Your Sun in their 7th house: around you, they may start thinking about partnership in earnest.
sun-8-theirs: Their Sun in your 8th house: they're hard to ignore, and their pull grows the closer you get. Staying on the surface may feel hard.
sun-8-yours: Your Sun in their 8th house: around you, they're drawn somewhere deeper. What's between you can get serious quickly.
sun-11-theirs: Their Sun in your 11th house: the friendship side is strong; you may feel like you belong to the same circle.
sun-11-yours: Your Sun in their 11th house: they see you as a companion before a lover. That's how the ground for lasting bonds is laid.
sun-12-theirs: Their Sun in your 12th house: they're hard to describe but easy to feel. Something about them is familiar, yet you can't quite name it.
sun-12-yours: Your Sun in their 12th house: they see something in you they can't put into words. That can be both alluring and hazy.
moon-1-theirs: Their Moon in your 1st house: around you, their feelings surface quickly. The way they see you becomes the way you try to come across.
moon-1-yours: Your Moon in their 1st house: they read you emotionally from the very start. Keeping up a mask for long may get harder.
moon-5-theirs: Their Moon in your 5th house: they don't hold back from showing what they feel for you. Spoiling and being spoiled comes easily between you.
moon-5-yours: Your Moon in their 5th house: around you, their childlike side may come out. Your feelings flow through play.
moon-7-theirs: Their Moon in your 7th house: they look for a sense of home with you. This placement tends to turn the relationship into an 'us' quickly.
moon-7-yours: Your Moon in their 7th house: around you, they want to settle down. The feeling of safety comes before the idea of partnership.
moon-8-theirs: Their Moon in your 8th house: their feelings don't stay on the surface; they sink straight to the depths. Intensity comes early, the right measure later.
moon-8-yours: Your Moon in their 8th house: they sense what you keep hidden. This can lead to trust or to vulnerability.
moon-11-theirs: Their Moon in your 11th house: emotional closeness comes through friendship. An easygoing, unpretentious warmth.
moon-11-yours: Your Moon in their 11th house: around you, they feel at ease even in a crowd. Feelings here don't need to show off.
moon-12-theirs: Their Moon in your 12th house: they may find it hard to tell you what they feel. A lot goes unsaid, and most of it is well meant.
moon-12-yours: Your Moon in their 12th house: they feel your emotions without you having to explain them. Closeness here is built quietly.
mercury-1-theirs: Their Mercury in your 1st house: talking to you is their first reflex. You meet through conversation, and that's how it carries on.
mercury-1-yours: Your Mercury in their 1st house: they get to know you first by the way you talk. Your words make the first impression.
mercury-5-theirs: Their Mercury in your 5th house: bantering, teasing and flirting come easily to them. Here, wit is a way of flirting.
mercury-5-yours: Your Mercury in their 5th house: they get hooked on your sense of humor. Your conversations play out like a game.
mercury-7-theirs: Their Mercury in your 7th house: they like making decisions and thinking things through with you. Here, partnership is built by talking.
mercury-7-yours: Your Mercury in their 7th house: they may come to feel uneasy without your input. You'll often be the one they consult.
mercury-8-theirs: Their Mercury in your 8th house: conversations get deep quickly. Small talk may bore you both.
mercury-8-yours: Your Mercury in their 8th house: they take what you say seriously. Your words carry more weight than you think.
mercury-11-theirs: Their Mercury in your 11th house: you're curious about the same things. Making plans, talking and dreaming come easily.
mercury-11-yours: Your Mercury in their 11th house: they see you as a thinking partner. Talk about the future may start early.
mercury-12-theirs: Their Mercury in your 12th house: what they leave unsaid may outweigh what they say. Their silences are sentences too.
mercury-12-yours: Your Mercury in their 12th house: they get what you mean before you find the words. Misunderstandings come from the same place.
venus-1-theirs: Their Venus in your 1st house: they don't hide that they like you. Your looks and your manner speak straight to them.
venus-1-yours: Your Venus in their 1st house: they find you attractive from the first moment. This placement's effect starts the moment you meet.
venus-5-theirs: Their Venus in your 5th house: flirting with you is a pleasure for them. Romance in its light, playful form.
venus-5-yours: Your Venus in their 5th house: with you, they feel like they're in love. One of the classic romantic placements.
venus-7-theirs: Their Venus in your 7th house: the way they love looks just like what you seek in a partner. A strong sign for partnership.
venus-7-yours: Your Venus in their 7th house: they read you as someone they could see by their side for a long time.
venus-8-theirs: Their Venus in your 8th house: the attraction doesn't stay on the surface. Closeness here is both binding and intense.
venus-8-yours: Your Venus in their 8th house: they can't easily stay indifferent to you. Finding the right dose of what's between you may take time.
venus-11-theirs: Their Venus in your 11th house: love and friendship are intertwined. An easy, pressure-free closeness full of shared laughs.
venus-11-yours: Your Venus in their 11th house: they want you as both a lover and a friend. Here, the two don't clash.
venus-12-theirs: Their Venus in your 12th house: they may not be able to fully name what they feel for you. A romantic but blurry space.
venus-12-yours: Your Venus in their 12th house: they find something in you to idealize. It's lovely, but seeing the real you takes time.
mars-1-theirs: Their Mars in your 1st house: they get you moving, and sometimes test your patience. Their effect is physical and direct.
mars-1-yours: Your Mars in their 1st house: they feel your energy on them. The first impression you make isn't calm; it's vivid.
mars-5-theirs: Their Mars in your 5th house: chasing you is fun for them. The playful, fast-moving side of the attraction between you.
mars-5-yours: Your Mars in their 5th house: they find you exciting. It's easy to ignite; keeping it going is another matter.
mars-7-theirs: Their Mars in your 7th house: they can be both teammate and rival to you. The partnership runs high on energy, and on friction.
mars-7-yours: Your Mars in their 7th house: they can't easily overlook you. Moving together is either really good or really loud.
mars-8-theirs: Their Mars in your 8th house: desire here doesn't beat around the bush. Intensity comes early; talking about boundaries helps.
mars-8-yours: Your Mars in their 8th house: they find something in you they can't resist. The pull is strong; its measure is learned.
mars-11-theirs: Their Mars in your 11th house: doing something together brings you closer. The energy flows into a shared plan.
mars-11-yours: Your Mars in their 11th house: they see you as the person they want by their side. Taking action together comes naturally.
mars-12-theirs: Their Mars in your 12th house: they may struggle to say outright what they want. An unspoken tension can build up.
mars-12-yours: Your Mars in their 12th house: they sense your desire but can't name it. Things left unsaid grow here.
